observations: Personally inspected whole historical SVG as1280x720 image: fixed-base two-link mechanical arm, continuous hook at gold ring, capsule, two docks, central curved dome, dotted arch, separate three-part explanatory cards; navy/mint/gold palette.
SVG/ACTION bytes are recovered historical authoring inputs; reference is never a runtime texture. Requested content is the three mechanisms, not character emotion.
Actual unmodified draft native0/75/91 personally viewed: arm crosses dome in far hold despite original diagnostics passing. BEFORE and failed probes are preserved.
assumptions: Exactly one9-second authored mechanical demo,216frames24fps. No alternate characters, new renderer, hosted generation, physics engine or general collision planner.

Authored dimensions300/260 repair the visible interference while root, capsule/trajectory, hook contact, angular limits and damped response schedule remain unchanged. Dome/body/dock dimensions and visible strokes are shared by drawing and diagnostics.
Arc-length table is a finite chord approximation; clearances use conservative envelopes with explicit allowances. They do not prove pixel appearance or arbitrary-scene collision avoidance.

Spring response is analytic about a fixed equilibrium with author-triggered angular-velocity impulses. Final fade is an authored finite gate. Exact-end7.2+1.4 regression fixed without changing216nativeposes.
Accepted box/base+8source9331freeze and movies remain preserved. Owner acceptance is recorded separately from agent playback observations.

Back on left dock; final pointer response settles.
